summary: Frontend-only regression + feature validation for LensTranslate iteration 4 on mobile viewport (390x844). All 4 in-preview features work end-to-end: (1) overlay text-size segment persists via AsyncStorage 'overlay-prefs'; (2) opacity slider (@react-native-community/slider on web renders as role=slider div, NOT input[type=range]) is drag-able and keyboard-navigable, updates opacity-value label and preview panel bg, persists across reload; (3) history search filters by both original_text and translated_text, shows result count header, highlight, and history-no-results empty state; (4) startCapture options-object variant renders home & shows the build-required error-banner without crashing. Regressions (cadence -> home, copy-to-clipboard toast, theme toggle, clear-all -> hides search bar) all pass. No React Native / Expo deprecation issues detected. No blocking bugs.
critical_code_review_comments: settings.tsx: opacity commit only fires onSlidingComplete — drag-in-progress values are stored only in local state; if the user backgrounds the app mid-drag the value is lost. Acceptable UX-wise but worth noting.
history.tsx: search filter uses trimmed query but rendering (highlight/count) also uses the trimmed value — consistent. No issue.
index.tsx: loadFavoriteLangs() calls queryClient.fetchQuery on every focus indirectly via start(); harmless due to 1h staleTime.
prefs.ts: loadOverlayPrefs() clamps opacity to [MIN_OPACITY, 1] — good defensive handling.
seed_data_creation: Did NOT re-seed after history-clear-button test. Mongo collection test_database.translations is now empty (seed-1 and seed-2 were deleted by the clear-all test as instructed). If future tests need them, re-insert seed-1 (ja 冒険を始めるにはSTARTを押してください / 'Press START to begin the quest') and seed-2 (fr 'Bonjour le monde' / 'Hello world').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Slider on web is a role=slider div, not input[type=range]. To interact with @react-native-community/slider from Playwright use: (a) mouse.move -> mouse.down -> mouse.move(steps=N) -> mouse.up on the slider's bounding box, or (b) click the slider then use keyboard ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (each step moves by the slider's step value). Both trigger onSlidingComplete which persists. Also, after a page.reload() Expo Router may restore the last route (e.g. /settings) so navigate with page.goto('/') if you need Home. Viewport used: 390x844.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no failures. Verified: overlay-prefs localStorage key stores {textSize, opacity}; preview panel bg uses rgba(20,20,20,opacity); history search is case-insensitive and matches either field.
